text: Men Hebilanii kadi lepte ɗen ɓen funsirooɓe jawle mun ɗen yiinorgol yimɓe ɓen e yetteede e maɓɓe, ɓen ɓe gomɗiŋtaa Alla, ɓe gomɗiŋtaa kadi Ñalnde Darngal ; Men Maranii ɓen lepte hoynooje, ko jokkugol ɓe seytaane ngol woni ko majjini ɓe, kala non mo seytaane laatanii wondiɗɗo ciŋkodaaɗo : haray o bonii wondiɗɗo!
